# ToggleButtons { #anylumino.ToggleButtons }

```python
ToggleButtons(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
    button_style='',
    tooltips=None,
    icons=None,
)
```

Toggle-button selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type     | Description                                                     | Default    |
|--------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| options | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()` |
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| index | optional | Selected option index. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |
| button_style | optional | Predefined button style such as ``'primary'`` or ``'success'``. | `''` |
| tooltips | optional | Per-option tooltips. | `None` |
| icons | optional | Icon names for toggle-button options. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [button_style](#anylumino.ToggleButtons.button_style) | Use a predefined styling for the buttons. |
| [icons](#anylumino.ToggleButtons.icons) | Icons names for each button (FontAwesome names without the fa- prefix). |
| [style](#anylumino.ToggleButtons.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |
| [tooltips](#anylumino.ToggleButtons.tooltips) | Tooltips for each button. |
